Creating Content

How do I create accessible content?

Short Answer

Use clear language, meaningful headings, descriptive links, text alternatives for images and accessible document formats. Check content with relevant accessibility tools.

Detailed Guidance

Structure content with descriptive headings, plain language and meaningful link text. Add text alternatives for informative images, use sufficient colour contrast, caption audio or video, and check documents with accessibility tools before sharing them.
